donor_field: sample_id (one sample per donor; Supp Table 1c)

matrix_qc.interpretation: X = log1p(raw integer UMI counts) without library-size normalisation

expression_definition.mean_log1p_cp10k: per-nucleus log1p(UMI / library size * 1e4), then arithmetic mean over nuclei
expression_definition.mean_log1p_cp10k_positive: same, restricted to nuclei with UMI > 0
expression_definition.mean_cp10k_per_nucleus: arithmetic mean of per-nucleus CP10k (linear scale)
expression_definition.pseudobulk_cp10k: sum of gene UMIs / sum of library sizes * 1e4 within the group
expression_definition.library_size: per-nucleus total UMI reconstructed as sum(round(expm1(X)))

contrast_definition: within-donor group vs all other nuclei; donors need >=20 nuclei on each side; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on donor-level pct_expr and mean_log1p_cp10k; BH across all contrasts of one metric (9); exact two-sided sign test on direction; trimester not adjusted
origin_definition: author_cell_type_origin from Supplementary Table 13a/b; NOT per-cell genotype
